description: Signal types, descriptions, investigation outcomes, and deterministic reward ranges.

mineral_signature.label: Mineral signature
mineral_signature.description: A concentrated mineral trace suitable for a resource survey.
mineral_signature.outcome: Survey complete: recoverable mineral fragments have been collected and logged in the ship inventory.

derelict_signal.label: Derelict transmission
derelict_signal.description: A repeating automated signal with no confirmed active crew.
derelict_signal.outcome: The signal led to a recoverable cache of salvage components. The recovered parts are now in inventory.

spatial_anomaly.label: Spatial anomaly
spatial_anomaly.description: A localized distortion in the system’s background telemetry.
spatial_anomaly.outcome: Telemetry captured useful anomaly research data. The research sample is now in inventory.

energy_residue.label: Energy residue
energy_residue.description: Residual energy readings that may indicate a recent high-output event.
energy_residue.outcome: The residue yielded intact energy cells. The recovered cells are now in inventory.

unusual_asteroid.label: Unusual asteroid body
unusual_asteroid.description: An asteroid body with an atypical spectral profile.
unusual_asteroid.outcome: A sample of the unusual asteroid was recovered and catalogued in inventory.

unknown_beacon.label: Unidentified beacon
unknown_beacon.description: A beacon is broadcasting a short, repeating identification burst.
unknown_beacon.outcome: The beacon yielded a recoverable navigation data fragment. The intel fragment is now in inventory.

scan_rules.description: Minimum and maximum distinct signals generated per first scan of a system.
